expectations.text: The normal sequence is authorize, import, review mappings, Start sync after all mapped; import alone does not start sync.
expectations.evidence: Steps 1–4 authorize, import products, review mappings, and Start sync only once all rows are mapped; explicitly says import alone does not start order sync.

expectations.text: It gives Mapping status location, Mapped/Unmatched conditions, and Link item or inventory-lead remedy only for Unmatched rows.
expectations.evidence: Step 3 gives Connections > Products and Mapping status. Mapped rows remain unchanged; only the Unmatched branch instructs Link item or asking the lead to create a missing inventory item before linking.

expectations.text: Disconnect/reimport and Reauthorize are clearly conditional on wrong shop and Authorization expired respectively, not universal prerequisites.
expectations.evidence: Recovery paragraphs condition Disconnect/authorize/reimport on the wrong shop in Connections > Account and Reauthorize on Authorization expired; neither is in the universal setup sequence.
